purpose: Read-only terminal inspection of explicitly owned Rouaix jobs, including unsuccessful attempts. Exploratory diagnostics, no scientific gate decision.

resources.launch_order: Preserve failed v2 smoke; submit repaired v3 baseline smoke. Gate three remaining-parent auditors on smoke success and afterany parent completion. Newly completed 96-rank and profiling runs receive direct terminal audits, avoiding duplicate postprocessing.
resources.stop_conditions: 10 minute Slurm cap; no requeue; integrity/parser errors preserve evidence and fail the audit. No CFD parent mutation, full-field download, or external dashboard upload.
